names.ja: フィカス・エラスティカ

light.best.quote: under bright indirect light or partial shade and protection from the afternoon sun

light.min.quote: Rubber Plant does best in partial shade or low light

light.min.reason: 出典は暗めでもよいとするが、暗いと間延びして葉を落としやすいため「やや明るい」までとした

light.directSun.quote: They grow best with the morning light from an east window.

temperature.minC.quote: Avoid temperatures lower than 55° F, sudden drops in temperatures, and cold drafts.

temperature.idealC.quote: The ideal temperatures are 60 to 65 °F at night and 75 to 80 °F during the day.

watering.winter.quote: Reduce watering altogether when the plant is dormant (from fall to late winter).

tips.ja: 置き場所を変えたり、すきま風や寒さに当たると葉を落としやすい。
tips.quote: Rubber Plant prefers to remain in one location and do not do well with drafts or cold temperatures.

tips.ja: 土がずっと湿っていると葉が黄色くなる。
tips.quote: Leaf yellowing may occur if the soil stays too wet.

tips.ja: 光不足・乾燥・冷たいすきま風で葉が落ちる。
tips.quote: Too little light, dry air or cold drafts may cause leaf loss.

tips.ja: 植え替えは晩冬〜早春に。
tips.quote: Repot in late winter or early spring if needed.
